reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending, takes its categories from the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and its sign from averageToBudget.

duplication.why: No logic is copied across actions; the only redundancy is the repeated '!includeHiddenCategories &&' in the hidden condition and the same optional flag declared on each action signature.

placement.why: Template, #fixed and hidden exclusions all live in the shared selection function in budget/actions.ts; the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the bulk-action selection, the new action, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: One selection function owns the rule, but the #fixed regex is inlined, the notes join is added without selecting group_notes, and the old includeHidden variation for setZero is silently folded into the new flag.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All bulk actions call getBulkBudgetCategories; none filters categories itself.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the new action composes existing helpers.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories swaps includeHidden for includeHiddenCategories (one public option) and gains the template and #fixed rules as general conditions, not caller-specific branches; all six bulk actions use it.
